biography: Todd Hazelwood, hailing from the sun-baked karting circuits of rural South Australia, discovered his passion for speed at a young age. His father, a weekend warrior racer himself, introduced Todd to the thrill of competition, spending countless hours wrenching on karts in their shed. One pivotal moment came during the state championships when, despite a mechanical failure in qualifying, Todd fought his way from last place to secure a podium finish, showcasing his raw talent and unwavering determination. This gritty performance caught the eye of Bebeto Tyres Racing, who offered him a junior development contract. Now, at 24, Todd is a rising star in the Australian Supercars Championship, proving his mettle against seasoned veterans. While he's yet to secure a championship title, his consistent performances and calculated approach have positioned him as a driver to watch.
drivingStyle: Hazelwood's driving style is characterized by a calculated and precise approach. He meticulously analyzes track conditions and opponent behavior before making his move. He is exceptionally good at managing tire wear, often extending his stints longer than his rivals, and uses this advantage to gain track position. While not the flashiest driver, he is known for his consistent lap times and ability to stay out of trouble, making him a formidable competitor in endurance races.

rivalries.reason: Zara and Todd have a long-standing rivalry dating back to their karting days. Zara's aggressive and flamboyant style clashes with Todd's calculated approach, leading to numerous on-track incidents.

Kenji, a recent import from the Japanese Super GT series, quickly established himself as a rival to Todd due to their similar driving styles and intense competition for podium positions. Their battles are often strategic and tactical, a chess match on wheels.

Rex is an old-school brawler, always looking for a gap, even when it's barely there. Todd's patience is often tested by Rex's aggressive maneuvers, leading to heated exchanges both on and off the track.

quirks: Always wears the same pair of lucky socks, gifted to him by his grandmother, for every race.
Before each race, he meticulously cleans and polishes his helmet visor, believing a clear vision is key to success.
He listens to classical music to calm his nerves and focus before getting into the car.
famousQuote: Racing isn't about raw speed alone; it's about understanding the game, anticipating your opponents, and making the right calculations at the right time.
careerHighlight: Winning the Bathurst 1000 in his rookie year as a co-driver, taking the lead in the final laps after a strategic fuel-saving gamble.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead on the final lap of the Adelaide 500 due to a mechanical failure, costing him his first solo Supercars victory.
